relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that intraplantar injection of RTX completely prevented the nerve-injury-induced thermal and mechanical hypersensitivities.

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 mRNA expression level was found significantly (Figure 8A,B; p < 0.05; p < 0.01) decreased in the ipsilateral RTX-treated left L3 and L4 DRGs compared to vehicle-treated L3 and L4 DRGs.

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: Triple immunofluorescent labelling showed that the RTX injection caused downregulation of TRPV1, IB4 and CGRP in the same medial aspect of the dorsal horn of the ipsilateral side of the L3–L5 segments

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, RTX caused upregulation of VIP labelling in the same areas where TRPV1-, IB4- and CGRP-immunoreactivities were downregulated

key_findings: Intraplantar RTX completely reversed and prevented thermal and mechanical hypersensitivity after L5 nerve injury
RTX downregulated TRPV1, CGRP and IB4 and upregulated VIP in DRG and dorsal horn, likely via neuroplasticity rather than neuronal loss
